metabolic_screening.state_form_note: VT has a standalone 'Refusal to Consent to Newborn Screening' form. Religious exemption available. The form covers bloodspot screening and is used for home/unattended births. Signed refusal retained in the newborn's record.
metabolic_screening.kit_ordering_note: NBS supplies ordered through VT DOH; specimens shipped to Vermont State Laboratory.
metabolic_screening.specimen_tracking_note: NBS tracking via VT State Laboratory; midwives verify specimen receipt.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Complete VT NBS TRF 12â48h after birth, give refusal form to parents if declining, send specimen+TRF to VT lab.
metabolic_screening.declination_law: VT statute â religious exemption available; refusal form required for declination.

billing.note: Parents are billed directly; most insurance covers screening; midwife is NOT billed for the screening test itself.

hearing_screening.program: Vermont EHDI Program â VT DOH
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Hearing screening refusal uses the same Refusal to Consent form. VT screening is part of the NBS panel; refusal documented on the form.
